messages.text:
Hello,

I have a quick question regarding my Nexus S1 order **Shop····**, placed on October 11.

The U. shipping label was created on October 15, but according to the tracking information, UPS has not received the package yet.

Interestingly, my Thor P2 order, which I placed later, has already been shipped and is in transit.

Could you please check whether my Nexus S1 is physically in stock at the EU warehouse and when it is expected to be handed over to UPS?

Thank you very much for your help!
Happy to check that for you. What's the email on order Shop····? Once I have it I can pull the order and the warehouse record and tell you exactly where the Nexus S1 sits and when it goes out.

Checked it. Your Nexus S1 was in stock at our Rotterdam warehouse, picked and packed, and the shipment completed on October 15 from there, so nothing is waiting on stock. Tracking is (number hidden): (tracking link hidden) and delivery is estimated October 22. The first carrier scan can lag a couple of days after a label is made, especially over a weekend. If it still shows no movement by Monday, tell me and I'll chase the warehouse on it.
Thank you very much, Sarah, for checking and providing such detailed information! I really appreciate your help and the update. Have a wonderful weekend!
Before you go, one thing: you ordered the Thor P2 three days after the S1. What made you add a second miner so soon?
